implementation_boundaries: Strict detached artifact_contract is off by default and bound before Popen; completion cannot enable, remove or redirect it retrospectively.

Artifact occurrence identity derives from full producer AttemptRef, logical output name and scope, not bytes or specification. Equal-content outputs may be distinct occurrences without proving independent science.
New inode snapshot copy, hash, fsync and bounded readback are outside effect lock and SQLite transaction. Short terminal publication rechecks captured source/snapshot identities.
Artifact rows, complete declared set and terminal artifact_ids share one SQLite transaction, with exact final artifact readback after terminal writes.
Existing deterministic staging is never blindly adopted or overwritten; a failed poll cannot create another large orphan for the same occurrence on every retry.
Default-off, declared empty outputs, and failed opt-in outcomes are separately represented. Zero bytes remain zero bytes; no measurement is invented.
limits: Only B1 is closed. Evaluation output physical isolation, immutable observations, explicit replication admission and real CPU autoresearch remain unfinished.
Native tests use actual launcher/completion/SQLite/file IO with explicitly substituted process and GPU ownership boundaries; they are not actual CPU or GPU experiments.
Historical artifact lookup is read-only metadata and does not prove confirmed lifecycle completion or scientific validity.
Mode 0400 is cooperative immutability, not protection from hostile same-UID writes. Arbitrary direct SQL/filesystem changes are outside the insert-only API.
File staging and SQL commit are not atomic. Unaccepted staging/effect HOLD can remain; no automatic orphan adoption, crash recovery or garbage collection is provided in B1.
Store methods require caller-owned transactions; any error requires whole caller rollback. Python exposes in_transaction, not the already acquired SQLite locking mode.
Legacy training specification fingerprint combines existing execution identity and output declaration, not complete independently verified scientific data/protocol identity.
No research-throughput percentage, statistical conclusion, paid provider call, production licensing, GPU training, holdout inspection, main merge, release or deployment is claimed.
